pregnancy_weeks.fetal_development: Baby is around 1.3 pounds and 12 inches long. Taste buds are forming, lungs are developing branch structures.
pregnancy_weeks.maternal_changes: Uterine growth above navel, mild back aches, potential Braxton Hicks contractions, increased appetite.
pregnancy_weeks.anc_visit_milestone: Glucose Tolerance Test (GTT) screening for gestational diabetes, blood pressure check, fundal height measurement.
warning_signs: Persistent severe headache with visual disturbances
lifestyle_recommendations: Sleep on the left side to optimize blood flow
Stay hydrated (2.5 to 3 liters of water daily)

eligibility_criteria: Pregnant women and lactating mothers for first and second child (if second child is female)
Must not be in regular employment with Central/State Government or PSUs
schemes.benefits_description: Direct cash transfer of ₹5,000 in two installments upon fulfilling ANC and child vaccination milestones.
documents_required: Bank Account Details linked with NPCI/Aadhaar
MCP Card (Mother and Child Protection Card)
application_steps: Register at local Anganwadi Centre (AWC) or ASHA worker unit within 150 days of LMP.
Submit Form 1-A with MCP card details and bank account proof.
Receive first installment upon pregnancy registration and minimum 1 ANC checkup.

eligibility_criteria: All pregnant women delivering in public health institutions or accredited private hospitals
schemes.benefits_description: Cash assistance for institutional delivery: ₹1,400 (Rural) and ₹1,000 (Urban).
documents_required: BPL Card or Caste Certificate (if applicable)
application_steps: Link with local ASHA worker during 3rd trimester.
Opt for delivery at an accredited health facility.
Cash assistance disbursed directly to bank account upon discharge.
